VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria requires objective verification that "all 23 tests pass," but only a self-report (SELF provenance) is provided. Without independent artifacts such as CI logs, test output, diffs, or signed attestations (SIGN), there is no way to independently verify that the tests actually pass or that the fix was correctly implemented. Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand measurable, verifiable outcomes.
